palette_name: Fantasy farm pale meadow with all-green grass-covered raised banks
lower_description: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly a flat solid muted medium green #43894f, with extremely sparse tiny 1-2 pixel grass strokes in #4e9557 and #397d48. Simple clean low-detail cozy farming-game pixel art, 16x16 tiles. Match this dark normal grass as the lower ground. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front edge, ground top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No flowers, stones, weeds, bushes, shadows from objects or outlines around tiles.
upper_description: A low raised grass-covered mound, one small 3-4 pixel step above the normal lawn. Preserve the existing pale spring-green short-grass upper surface (#8cbd75, #76ac64, #a5cc86) and sparse tiny markings. The ENTIRE vertical front face and all side edges are also covered in living green turf and short hanging grass. No exposed soil or brown pixels anywhere. Show the height through a pale green top lip, mid-green grassy vertical bank and a narrow dark green contact shadow at its foot. The edge should look like a continuous thick carpet of grass wrapping down the slope, not a dirt cliff, rock wall or hedge. Broad flat walkable top. Match the simple 16px cozy farm style of the supplied base terrain tiles. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No flowers, bushes, vines, stones, wood or props.
transition_description: A shallow 3-4 pixel vertical step completely coated in GREEN GRASS. Pale green upper turf rolls over the lip, with tiny hanging green blade clusters on the face, a slightly darker green grass bank and a thin dark green foot shadow. Keep the relief readable using only greens. NO brown earth, dirt, exposed soil, tan, ochre, rock or stone. Seamless straight edges, convex corners and concave corners; same compact raised geometry as the connected base tiles.
